package dev.sora.protohax

import android.os.Build
import android.util.Log
import io.netty.buffer.Unpooled
import dev.sora.protohax.relay.MinecraftRelay as AppRelay
import dev.sora.relay.game.GameSession
import dev.sora.relay.game.entity.EntityLocalPlayer
import dev.sora.relay.game.management.BlobCacheManager
import dev.sora.relay.game.registry.BlockMapping
import dev.sora.relay.game.registry.ItemMapping
import dev.sora.relay.game.registry.LegacyBlockMapping
import dev.sora.relay.game.utils.MineUtils
import dev.sora.relay.game.utils.constants.EnumFacing
import dev.sora.relay.game.utils.constants.ItemTags
import dev.sora.relay.game.world.Level
import dev.sora.relay.session.listener.RelayListenerAutoCodec
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector2f
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3f
import org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.Vector3i
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.compat.BedrockCompat
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v2193.Bedrock_v2193
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.codec.v844.Bedrock_v844
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.biome.BiomeDefinitionData
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.skin.SerializedSkin
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.packet.MovePlayerPacket
import org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.util.EncryptionUtils

/**
 * TEMPORARY startup probe, injected by .github/workflows/diag.yml only (never part of a product build).
 *
 * It forces the classes of the relay start-up chain to initialise one by one - lowest level first -
 * on a real ART runtime with the real R8 output, and logs the complete cause chain of the FIRST
 * failure of each one (later users of a failed class only see ART's plain NoClassDefFoundError).
 */
internal object DiagProbe {

    private const val TAG = "DIAG"

    private fun chain(t: Throwable): String {
        val sb = StringBuilder()
        var c: Throwable? = t
        var depth = 0
        while (c != null && depth < 8) {
            sb.append(if (depth == 0) "  " else "  caused by: ")
                .append(c.javaClass.name).append(": ").append(c.message).append('\n')
            for (e in c.stackTrace.take(14)) {
                sb.append("      at ").append(e.toString()).append('\n')
            }
            c = if (c.cause === c) null else c.cause
            depth++
        }
        return sb.toString()
    }

    internal fun step(name: String, block: () -> Any?) {
        val t0 = System.currentTimeMillis()
        try {
            val r = block()
            Log.i(TAG, "OK   " + name + " -> " + r + " (" + (System.currentTimeMillis() - t0) + " ms)")
        } catch (t: Throwable) {
            Log.e(TAG, "FAIL " + name + "\n" + chain(t))
        }
    }

    internal fun touch(cls: Class<*>) = step("init " + cls.name) {
        Class.forName(cls.name, true, cls.classLoader)
        "initialised"
    }

    fun start() {
        Thread({
            try {
                Thread.sleep(3000)
            } catch (e: InterruptedException) {
                // ignore
            }
            execute()
        }, "diag-probe").start()
    }

    private fun execute() {
        Log.i(TAG, "BEGIN probe sdk=" + Build.VERSION.SDK_INT + " abis=" + Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.joinToString())

        // 1. math library: needs META-INF/services/org.cloudburstmc.math.vector.VectorProvider at runtime
        step("Vector3f.from") { Vector3f.from(1f, 2f, 3f) }
        step("Vector3i.from") { Vector3i.from(1, 2, 3) }
        step("Vector2f.from") { Vector2f.from(1f, 2f) }

        // 2. static initialisers reached by GameSession and its members (lowest level first)
        touch(EnumFacing::class.java)
        touch(ItemTags::class.java)
        touch(MineUtils::class.java)
        touch(LegacyBlockMapping::class.java)
        touch(ItemMapping.Provider::class.java)
        touch(BlockMapping.Provider::class.java)
        step("ItemMapping.Provider.craftMapping(844)") { ItemMapping.Provider.craftMapping(844); "ok" }
        step("BlockMapping.Provider.craftMapping(844)") { BlockMapping.Provider.craftMapping(844); "ok" }
        touch(BlobCacheManager::class.java)
        touch(EntityLocalPlayer::class.java)
        touch(Level::class.java)
        touch(GameSession::class.java)
        step("new GameSession()") { GameSession(); "constructed" }

        // 3. protocol codecs
        touch(Bedrock_v844::class.java)
        step("Bedrock_v844.CODEC") { "protocol=" + Bedrock_v844.CODEC.protocolVersion + " mc=" + Bedrock_v844.CODEC.minecraftVersion }
        touch(BedrockCompat::class.java)
        touch(Bedrock_v2193::class.java)
        step("Bedrock_v2193.CODEC") { "protocol=" + Bedrock_v2193.CODEC.protocolVersion + " mc=" + Bedrock_v2193.CODEC.minecraftVersion }
        touch(RelayListenerAutoCodec::class.java)
        touch(dev.sora.relay.MinecraftRelay::class.java)

        // 4. the application's own relay object and the exact call AppService makes
        touch(AppRelay::class.java)
        step("AppRelay.session") { AppRelay.session; "ok" }
        step("AppRelay loader thread") {
            AppRelay.loaderThread?.join(90000)
            "modules registered=" + AppRelay.moduleManager.modules.size
        }
        step("AppRelay.announceRelayUp()") { AppRelay.announceRelayUp(); "relay up" }

        // 5. java.awt.Color is absent on Android: protocol classes must use the relocated stand-in
        step("java.awt.Color exists on this device?") {
            try {
                Class.forName("java.awt.Color")
                "PRESENT"
            } catch (e: ClassNotFoundException) {
                "absent (expected on Android)"
            }
        }
        touch(SerializedSkin::class.java)
        touch(BiomeDefinitionData::class.java)

        // 6. login handshake: jose4j + JCA under R8/ART
        step("EncryptionUtils key pair + handshake JWT + shared secret + cipher") {
            val kp = EncryptionUtils.createKeyPair()
            val token = EncryptionUtils.generateRandomToken()
            val jwt = EncryptionUtils.createHandshakeJwt(kp, token)
            val secret = EncryptionUtils.getSecretKey(kp.private, kp.public, token)
            val cipher = EncryptionUtils.createCipher(true, true, secret)
            "jwt chars=" + jwt.length + " secret=" + secret.algorithm + " cipher=" + cipher.algorithm
        }

        // 7. a vector-heavy packet through the real v844 codec (encode, then decode)
        step("MovePlayerPacket round trip through the v844 codec") {
            val codec = Bedrock_v844.CODEC
            val helper = codec.createHelper()
            val pkt = MovePlayerPacket().apply {
                runtimeEntityId = 7L
                position = Vector3f.from(1.5f, 64f, -3.25f)
                rotation = Vector3f.from(10f, 20f, 30f)
                mode = MovePlayerPacket.Mode.NORMAL
                isOnGround = true
                tick = 99L
            }
            val buf = Unpooled.buffer()
            codec.tryEncode(helper, buf, pkt)
            val size = buf.readableBytes()
            val id = codec.getPacketDefinition(MovePlayerPacket::class.java).id
            val back = codec.tryDecode(helper, buf, id) as MovePlayerPacket
            "id=" + id + " bytes=" + size + " pos=" + back.position + " rot=" + back.rotation + " tick=" + back.tick
        }

        // DIAG-AWT-HOOK

        Log.i(TAG, "END probe")
    }
}
